summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The return reports movements in authorized and issued share capital for July 2026, showing no changes in issued shares (3,201,250,981 ordinary shares outstanding, 10,804,675 treasury shares) and confirming compliance with public float requirements. This is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing discloses no transaction terms or strategic actions.
